_comment: E2-B1's population: the loops whose deciding fact (may the hot loop run in parallel?) is NOT in the loop's own statements. Campaign INPUT for tools/e2b1_stats.py, written from the author's decisions of 27 Sep BEFORE any E2-B1 measurement, and FROZEN before E2-B1's first trial: after that a unit changes only by the substitution rule below, each substitution logged in `substitutions` with its reason and a row in THESIS_EXPERIMENTS.md §6. Names are the harness's benchmark names (<suite>/<kernel>); the Rodinia bfs package (prepare_bfs.py) generates a deterministic synthetic graph as its input, a recorded deviation. s258 is packaged with a recorded deviation (the author, 27 Sep: LEN_2D = LEN_1D and `aa` one row, in its harness header; record §6).
recorded: THESIS_EXPERIMENTS.md §6, 2026-09-27, "The author's decisions on E2-B1's design" (the recommendations of docs/e2b1/PREPARATION.md §2); the selection rule of 2026-09-26 ("The selection rule, written before any benchmark is picked from the screen")
substitution_rule: One unit per duplicate group, the FIRST in the source's own order. A unit that fails a hard constraint or a measured condition (PREPARATION.md §3: T0.1 sizes, prepare --validate, naive_pragma.py, T0.11 class and the profile naming (a) / not naming (b) the deciding dependence, routing_check.py on the three draws, a hand-read) leaves with the reason recorded, and the next member of its group in source order enters. No exclusion for effort or for looking weak; never a substitution chosen by any arm's result.

substitutions.reason: measured condition 4: T0.11 class R in 3 of 3 draws (t0_11_b1_a/b/c) where direction (b) requires class A — its break makes DiscoPoP find no Do-All; predicted by the screen
substitutions.why_none: its own screen group (dup-of —): no next member in source order

a.role: tier 1 CONFIRMATORY (the named tests join the campaign's Holm family, 27 Sep decision 4); tier 2 reported apart, descriptive
